description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order under the Universities Act, to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 1454/37 of 22.07.2006 substituting Department of Sanskrit and Eastern Studies
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to a university's departmental structure under the authority of the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. While it mentions Minister Kabir Hashim, it does not focus on his appointment or personal details (Type 2), nor does it combine personnel information with detailed portfolio responsibilities (Type 3). Instead, it constitutes a statutory instrument that modifies the legal framework governing university faculties and departments, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette under Type 5.
